messages:
Mira: If you were a board game, which one would you be and why? Random question for the afternoon :boardgame:
Alex: Ticket to Ride — I always want to connect things and make neat plans :train:
Jamal: Pandemic. ironic but accurate, I’m the person trying to save everyone :mask:
Olivia: Betrayal at House on the Hill — chaotic and dramatic tbh :skull:
Ben: Chess. silent, strategic, slightly judgemental pieces :chess_pawn:
Mira: @Alex love the planning. @Ben that fits.
Alex: also low-key enjoy the drama of grabbing a long route and denying people :smile:
Olivia: Anyone pick Monopoly? pls don't roast me, I grew up loving it :sweat_smile:
Jamal: Monopoly = personality trait not a board game choice :joy:
lunch-bot: Lunch reminder: pizza in the kitchen at 12:30 :pizza: (not related but thought I'd drop in)
Priya: I'm more of a Dixit person — whimsical vibes, weird art, big imagination :sparkles:
Ben: quick poll: who'd win in a company tournament? Chess (Ben), Ticket to Ride (Alex), Dixit (Priya), Pandemic (Jamal), Betrayal (Olivia), Monopoly (Olivia)
Mira: results: everyone picks their own game, democracy achieved :thumbsup:
Alex: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/boardgames-fun-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40
Olivia: Also follow-up: 2 truths 1 lie — I own more board games than shoes :nerd_face:
Mira: ok that is a follow-up thread, nice. Thanks y'all :heart:
